derivation: perhaps by compounding H6567 (פָּרָשׁ) and H6504 (פָּרַד) (in the sense of straddling) (compare H6576 (פַּרְשֵׁז));

occurrences.text: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
